method: Independent full ordered-word reconstruction of the input basis and every selected first-leg contraction; exact 1|2 time-reversal pullback; rational separating identity; strict positive-definite LDL factorizations and their reconstructions. Standard library only, no discovery imports.
scope: Universal exclusion of pure sixth-order AC states on 21 qubits.
statement: No pure sixth-order AC state on 21 qubits exists; the maximum pure-state AC order is at most 5.
